python3 -c "
import parse
p5 = parse.Parser('{name:l}')
m = p5.search('hello world', evaluate_result=False)

result = m.evaluate_result()
print('Result:', result)
print('__contains__ works:', 'hello' in m)
print('not in match:', 'world' in m)
" 2>&1 | tail -5
